opening: I have pain in my belly.
It came on suddenly, 16 hours ago.
I've had loose bowel movements with blood in them.
A week ago I was in the hospital for a heart attack.
I've had high blood pressure for 20 years.

opening.text: I have pain in my belly that came on suddenly 16 hours ago, and it is severe. I've also had loose bowel movements with blood in them. A week ago I was in the hospital for a heart attack. I've had diabetes for 35 years and high blood pressure for 20 years.
